مُحْقِبٌ One who makes another to ride behind him on the same beast. (K.) ―
-b2- Hence, in a trad., المُحْقِبُ النَّاسَ دِيَنَهُ (assumed tropical:) He who makes his religion to follow that of others, without evidence, proof, or consideration. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
